forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {興|きょう}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to enjoy, to amuse oneself with, to indulge in
definitions.explanation: To take pleasure in an activity and become absorbed in it. Often used with games, conversations, and leisure activities. Carries a nuance of whiling away time pleasurably.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children are absorbed in a game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じた。
examples.english: I enjoyed conversation with my friends until late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅先|たびさき}→旅先：12949_tabisaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: I look forward to enjoying games of shogi with the locals at my travel accommodation.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the activity being enjoyed: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じる. Has a slightly literary or refined tone compared to casual alternatives like ⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Pattern: [activity]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じる
- Conjugates as an ichidan verb: {興|きょう}じる → {興|きょう}じて → {興|きょう}じた
- The variant {興|きょう}ずる (literary/classical) is also seen

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じる: to enjoy games
- ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じる: to enjoy conversation
- ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じる: to amuse oneself with play
- ⟦{宴|うたげ}→宴：12286_utage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興|きょう}じる: to enjoy a banquet
